description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying symbol performance data, including methods for updating data, creating view holders, binding data to views, and internal ViewHolder class.

classes.name: SymbolPerformanceAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying symbol performance, managing data and view binding.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set with new symbol performance data and refreshes the view.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates new ViewHolder instances by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder at the given position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of data items.

inner_class.name: ViewHolder
inner_class.description: Holds references to the item views and binds data to them.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a symbol's name and performance value to the item views, setting the text and color accordingly.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Updates internal data list with sorted entries from new data and notifies the RecyclerView.
